question: Fit the Michaelis-Menten equation to calculate Vmax and Km with and without inhibitor, and plot both the Michaelis-Menten and Lineweaver-Burk (double-reciprocal) curves to compare enzyme kinetics.

expected_output.description: rows as conditions (Control, Inhibitor), columns should include condition, Vmax, Km
1/[S] as x-axis, 1/V as y-axis, control and inhibitor overlaid
[S] as x-axis, V as y-axis, fitted curves for control and inhibitor with Vmax and Km annotated
